newsitem.title: USA: Biogen Inc to distribute MS drug in Greece.
newsitem.headline: Biogen Inc to distribute MS drug in Greece.

text.p: Biogen Inc said Monday that Genesis Pharma SA of Athens will be the exclusive distributor in Greece of its interferon beta-1a, marketed as AVONEX, for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis.

AVONEX, said the company, is already the leading therapy for multiple sclerosis in the U.S., with more than 23,000 patients taking the drug. Sales in the United States reached $76 million in the first seven months of the drug's availability.

The company also said it expects AVONEX to be approved for the European market during the first half of 1997. Biogen will commercialize AVONEX directly in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, France and the Benelux nations and will sell through distributors in other markets. It already has distribution arrangements with Schering-Plough SA in Spain and Portugal, Astra AB in the Nordic countries and Dompe SpA in Italy.

Genesis Pharma SA, a member company of the MSJ Group, is based in Athens. Its business activities are focused on the distribution of specialty pharmaceutical products, mainly resulting from biotechnological research.
